project: Roku v0.0.8 Direct Loop and Execution Substrate
description: Lock the current direct runtime loop contract, make ask-user resume behavior explicit, and introduce a narrower generic pending-loop substrate boundary for Roku v0.0.8.

userStories.title: Lock the ambiguous filesystem boundary regression
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want the current ambiguous filesystem lookup boundary covered by a targeted regression test so that later runtime changes do not silently re-break the direct loop contract.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update a targeted test that covers the current ambiguous-fs-find boundary case
The expected outcome for that case is explicit in test assertions, not only inferred from helper code

userStories.title: Add direct-route terminal trace guardrails
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want direct-route terminal trace assertions so that direct runtime terminal behavior stays visible and regression-proof.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update tests covering direct route terminal trace behavior
The covered assertions make the terminal path explicit without relying only on helper internals

userStories.title: Add pause and stale-discard trace guardrails
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want AwaitingUser and stale freeform discard trace assertions so that pause and discard behavior stop being defined only by scattered runtime behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update tests covering AwaitingUser trace behavior
Add or update tests covering stale freeform discard behavior

userStories.title: Add visible-resource projection trace guardrails
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want visible-resource projection assertions in the direct path so that resource visibility remains tied to explicit test anchors instead of implicit behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update tests covering visible resource projection in the direct path
The covered assertions make the projected resources explicit in the tested path

userStories.title: Add freeform ask-user resume contract test
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want the freeform ask-user resume outcome expressed in one targeted test so that freeform pause behavior is no longer hidden in shared helpers.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update one targeted test that covers the expected resume outcome for freeform ask-user behavior
The test asserts the expected freeform resume result explicitly

userStories.title: Add candidate-selection ask-user resume contract test
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want the candidate-selection ask-user resume outcome expressed in one targeted test so that candidate pause behavior is no longer hidden in shared helpers.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update one targeted test that covers the expected resume outcome for candidate-selection ask-user behavior
The test asserts the expected candidate-selection resume result explicitly

userStories.title: Add missing-input ask-user resume contract test
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want the missing-input ask-user resume outcome expressed in one targeted test so that missing-input pause behavior is no longer hidden in shared helpers.
acceptanceCriteria: Add or update one targeted test that covers the expected resume outcome for missing-input ask-user behavior
The test asserts the expected missing-input resume result explicitly

userStories.title: Introduce a generic pending-loop snapshot adapter boundary
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want one narrow runtime-facing adapter for generic pending-loop snapshots so that pending and resume stop depending only on RuntimeService in-memory maps.
acceptanceCriteria: Introduce one narrow runtime-facing adapter or interface for loading and storing generic pending-loop snapshots
Wire one covered runtime path through that adapter instead of treating the RuntimeService in-memory map as the only pending-loop truth
The new boundary is covered by at least one focused unit or integration test

userStories.title: Prove generic loop resume after service reconstruction
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want one reconstruction test for generic loop resume so that durable pending-loop work is not tied to a single process lifetime.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a test where a generic pending loop is stored, the service is reconstructed, and the loop resumes successfully
The test does not rely solely on Telegram-specific bridge behavior
The test asserts the resumed path continues through the generic loop driver

userStories.title: Extract one narrower runtime owner seam from RuntimeService
userStories.description: As a Roku developer, I want one narrower lifecycle seam around runtime ownership so that RuntimeService no longer directly owns every loop lifecycle detail on the covered path.
acceptanceCriteria: Extract one narrower helper, owner, or lifecycle seam around pending-resume or loop lifecycle handling
RuntimeService directly owns fewer loop lifecycle details after the change
Existing direct runtime tests still pass after the extraction
